data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Integration. SRC_002 and SRC_004 integrate to form a complete dialectic on the cost of Popperian epistemology: SRC_002 identifies the hidden inductive cost in action, while SRC_004 explicitly accepts the lack of guarantee as the price of maintaining a non-inductive stance. Refuted If: The 'cost' acknowledged in SRC_004 logically entails the 'smuggled induction' criticized in SRC_002, making them mutually exclusive descriptions of the same phenomenon rather than complementary perspectives.
